summary: Iteration 8: Tested Phase 6/7/10 features. Fixed 2 critical bugs: (1) QuizArena chapter dropdown URL mismatch - /subjects/{subject}/chapters vs /{subject}/chapters - chapters would NEVER load without this fix. (2) ProfilePage `nav` variable used but not declared (useNavigate() called but result not stored), causing crash on Upgrade/Change Plan button clicks. All backend endpoints pass (9/10 tests, 1 flaky due to test URL bug). Frontend: Quiz Arena subject→chapter→topic flow works after fix, Profile subscription section renders correctly, Mock Exam page loads normally.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Wrong URL for chapters endpoint - called /api/syllabus/{class}/subjects/{subject}/chapters instead of /api/syllabus/{class}/{subject}/chapters. Chapter dropdown would never populate.
FIXED: `nav` variable used in onClick handlers but useNavigate() result was not assigned to any variable. Would throw ReferenceError when Upgrade Plan or Change Plan button clicked.

issues: weak-area-tracker section not visible for admin user - correct behavior (no weak areas data yet). Works conditionally on weakAreas.weak_topics.length > 0

action_items: Both bugs FIXED in this iteration. No outstanding action items.
weak-area-tracker will show once admin completes a mock exam with wrong answers (data-driven).
Adaptive 'Auto-set' badge only shows when mastery.attempts > 0, which requires prior quiz history on that topic - correct behavior.

mock_exam.py: $addToSet with $each is valid MongoDB syntax for adding multiple items to array without duplicates - CORRECT
weak-areas endpoint correctly merges student_profiles.weak_topics + recent exam weak_topics with frequency counting - CORRECT
topic-mastery correctly handles missing profile (returns default medium difficulty) - CORRECT

success_rate.backend: 90% (9/10 - 1 test had URL bug in test file, endpoints themselves all work)
success_rate.frontend: 100% - All features verified after 2 bug fixes

rca_of_issues: 1. QuizArena chapters URL: Frontend called /api/syllabus/{class}/subjects/{subject}/chapters but the actual route registered in the backend is /syllabus/{class_id}/{subject}/chapters (without 'subjects' segment). Root cause: copy-paste from subjects endpoint URL pattern. Fix: remove the extra '/subjects/' segment. 2. ProfilePage nav: useNavigate() was imported but its return value was not stored in any variable. The JSX used `nav('/pricing')` in button onClick handlers but `nav` was undefined. Fix: added `const nav = useNavigate();` after the useSubscription() hook call.
